literal_meaning: চড়কের পিঠ (the back of the Charak swing or ritual apparatus)
figurative_meaning_bn: যে পিঠ সবই সহ্য করতে পারে
figurative_meaning_en: A back that can endure everything
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চড়কের পিঠের মতো সব অভিযোগ সহ্য করে।
জীবনের কষ্টগুলো চড়কের পিঠের মতো বহন করতে হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He endures all criticism like the back of a Charak.
One must bear life's hardships like the back of a Charak.
history: The idiom derives from Charak Puja, a traditional Bengali Hindu festival involving ritual swinging on a frame with hooks piercing the body, symbolizing extreme endurance and devotion.
note: Linked to the physical and spiritual resilience demonstrated in the Charak festival.
